name: Cybernetic Enhancement
body:
Prerequisite(s): Autrone, character level 3rd

Benefit(s): You’ve integrated advanced cybernetic enhancements into your system, allowing you to temporarily boost your physical or mental capabilities.

Once per day as a swift action, you can activate one of the following enhancements for 1 minute:

Strength Boost: Gain a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength.
Agility Boost: Gain a +2 enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Cognitive Boost: Gain a +2 enhancement bonus to Intelligence.

At 7th level and every 4 levels thereafter, you can use this ability one additional time per day.

Special: You can only have one enhancement active at a time. Activating a new enhancement ends any previous enhancement.
